{"metadata":{"description":"Codebase Memory MCP bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness: knowledge-graph code search, AST snippets, architecture analysis, call-graph tracing, auto-started graph UI, bundled skill, and /cbm command.","id":"gh:1398361534","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-codebase-memory-mcp","slug":"LoveDoLove/dsh-codebase-memory-mcp","topics":["ai","ai-agents","ast","call-graph","code-analysis","code-intelligence","code-search","coding-agents","deepseek-harness","developer-productivity","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","graph-visualization","knowledge-graph","mcp","mcp-client","model-context-protocol","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codebase Memory MCP bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness: knowledge-graph code search, AST snippets, a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rchitecture analysis, call-graph tracing, auto-started graph UI, bundled skill, and /cbm command."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @lovedolove/dsh-codebase-memory-mcp"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Standalone **Codebase Memory MCP bridge plugin and library** for DeepSeek
> Harness (DSH). Registe"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"rs six knowledge-graph code tools, manages a lazily
> started `codebase-memory-mcp` daemon with its "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"graph-visualization Web UI, and
> ships a bundled agent skill plus a `/cbm` status command."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Six knowledge-graph code tools** registered on the DSH tool surface:
`cbm_projects`, `cbm_search"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"`, `cbm_snippet`, `cbm_arch`, `cbm_trace`, and
`cbm_search_code`.
- **Lazy daemon and Web UI** — the"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" plugin does not start the daemon while it is
loading. The shared client spawns `codebase-memory-mcp"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" --ui=true --port=9749`
as a child process over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 the first time a tool call or
`/c"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"bm` needs it. If the child exits, the next request starts it again; the
client disposes it when the "},{"id":"p5s6","text":"plugin shuts down.
- **System-prompt guidance** — injects a *Codebase Memory — Knowledge Graph
Polic"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"y* section that tells the model when to prefer the graph tools over
`grep`/`read`.
- **Bundled agent"},{"id":"p5s8","text":" skill** — `skills/codebase-memory/SKILL.md`
is registered as a native bundled skill provider (`code"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"base-memory`, rank 600,
model- and user-invocable), so the model-facing `skill` tool can load it.
- "},{"id":"p5s10","text":"**`/cbm` slash command** — reports the resolved executable path, the Web UI
link, and the projects c"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"urrently indexed in the daemon.
- **Graceful degradation** — only `tools` is a hard dependency
(`inj"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"ect: ['tools']`); `systemPrompt`, `skills`, and `commands` are attached via
deferred `ctx.inject()`,"},{"id":"p5s13","text":" so a missing host service simply skips that feature.
The six tools are registered even when the exe"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"cutable is absent; calls return
a degraded result instead of failing to load the plugin.
- **Cross-p"},{"id":"p5s15","text":"latform executable detection** — `CBM_EXE` and
`CODEBASE_MEMORY_EXE` overrides, user and system dire"},{"id":"p5s16","text":"ctories, current working
directory, `PATH`, and a WSL interop fallback that locates
`codebase-memory"},{"id":"p5s17","text":"-mcp.exe` reachable from Linux/WSL.
- **Reusable library API** — the package exports the MCP client,"},{"id":"p5s18","text":" indexing engine,
repository discovery, sanitization, watcher, tool definitions, and type
constants,"},{"id":"p5s19","text":" so the bridge can be used without the DSH plugin layer."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Component | Version |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| DeepSeek Harness | `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (`dsh.compatibility.dshVersions`) |
